ModMetaData.name: Armory
ModMetaData.author: Kruecke
ModMetaData.description:
Shows, for every colonist, which weapons they would prefer and why they are not carrying them.
Armory ranks loose weapons for every colonist, split into a hand slot and an opposite-type backup, then shows the blockers: forbidden or outside the allowed area, unreachable, reserved, biocoded to someone else, role restrictions, and ideoligion dislike. The Demand tab lists every weapon that would improve a colonist, grouped into craft, research, and buy, and compares those options with what the colony already owns.
Automatic equipping is opt-in. When enabled it queues Equip jobs for the best ready weapon, claims each weapon for one pawn, respects a swap cooldown, never unforbids or breaks persona bonds, and pauses for pawns whose weapon was changed manually. The Log tab shows each action with the reason it was taken.
Simple Sidearms is supported through reflection. Armory respects forced primaries and unarmed states, follows the pawn's per-pawn ranged/melee primary mode, and models one hand weapon of that type plus one opposite-type backup. Backup assignment is optional and off by default; when enabled it keeps one legal opposite-type weapon in the pawn's inventory, upgrades only the worst weapon of the same type, and checks every candidate against Simple Sidearms' own slot, mass, and selection limits.
